changelog:
🎉 背群英 v2.51.0 已发布！

本次更新内容：

【修复】数据恢复显示条数不准确
- 恢复后现在显示实际数据条数（如479个进度+10个错词等）
- 不再只显示localStorage键数（10），而是显示完整数据明细

devNotes: v2.51.0: Fixed data restore message to show actual item counts (progress entries, wrong words, etc.) instead of just localStorage key count. Added restoreAllData helper with detailed breakdown. Also fixed typeof string check that could skip non-string values in BeiRiDan.
